mapper.select: select bookings.exam_id, subjects.subject, grades.grade, places.place, exam_infos.id as e_id, exam_infos.exam_date, exam_infos.old_date, exam_infos.comments, exam_infos.cancel from bookings join exam_infos on exam_id = exam_infos.id join subjects on exam_infos.subject_id = subjects.id join grades on exam_infos.grade_id = grades.id join places on exam_infos.place_id = places.id where exam_infos.exam_date >= curdate() and account_id = #{accountId}
select count(*) from bookings where exam_id = #{examId}
